title: Bound for a sum over a list
statement: Let $I$ be a finite list, let $w$ be a real-valued function on its element type, and let $B$ be a real number. If $w(i)\le B$ for every element $i$ occurring in the list, then the sum of $w(i)$ over the list is at most the length of the list times $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of elements of a type
A real-valued weight function on that type
Every element occurring in the list has weight at most $B$
